Thanks for flagging this — sorry for the friction. We did roll a minor Calendly widget update last week and have seen a handful of DST/zone edge cases where the UI confirmed the local time but the outgoing ICS used a different offset.

Quick options:
- I can send a manual calendar invite (ICS) for Tue 30 Mar 10:30 CET that should show consistently across clients.
- Marcus can run the demo and include an explicit UTC time in the invite description to avoid interpretation.
- If you prefer, we can switch to Chili Piper for scheduling (we have a hosted link that respects browser locale better in our experience).

Which do you prefer? If you confirm Tue 30 Mar 10:30 CET I will send the invite and attach a short agenda.

Apologies again — we'll raise a bug with the Calendly team and our widget owners.
